$comment: Generated by `mwops release write-rights-files` from package.json and model-card.json. Edit the generator or those files, never this one.
version_series_meaning: This package is a data-only overlay, and model_card_version names this overlay's own artifacts. The model graph its rows decode through is the one base_weights names, at that package's own model_card_version. Neither number is package_version, which moves in lockstep across every mailwoman workspace on every release.

inherited_lineage.note: These entries are @mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us's record of what its model graph was trained on. This package ships no graph and contributed none of these rows. Read them as the base's lineage rather than as a claim about this package's own artifacts, which are listed under artifacts and attributed under training_attribution.

attribution.text: HM Land Registry — Price Paid Data (OGL v3.0): the `synth-gb-v1` training extract (800,000 rows) NEW in 6.7.0. Crown copyright, attribution required. The GB placetype-pair index is built from the same source and ships in `neural-weights-en-gb`, whose own card carries its attribution.
LINZ-derived OpenAddresses NZ (CC-BY 4.0): the `synth-nz-v2` training extract (800,000 rows) NEW in 6.7.0.
OpenAddresses ES tuples (CC-BY per OA source): the `synth-es-pedania-v1` training extract (800,000 rows, below-municipio pedanía place names) NEW in 6.7.0.

BAN — Base Adresse Nationale (DINUM / IGN, Licence Ouverte 2.0): the `synth-fr-lieudit-v1` training extract (`nom_ld` lieu-dit field) NEW in 6.7.0, additional to the existing `synth-fr-fragment` extract (144,865 rows, 6.4.0).
Overture Maps Foundation — Addresses theme (CDLA-Permissive-2.0): the `overture-latam` CA/MX training extract (456,230 rows, 6.6.0). Attribution-only, not share-alike.
OpenAddresses CZ — ČÚZK RÚIAN (CC-BY 4.0): tokenizer-splice training text + the oa-cz coord eval sets
OpenAddresses PL — GUGiK / PRG (public, BDOT-derived): tokenizer-splice training text + the oa-pl coord eval sets
OpenAddresses SK — MINV/ZBGIS (CC-0/CC-BY per OA source): oa-sk coord eval set (free-rider validation)
OpenAddresses SI — GURS (CC-BY per OA source): oa-si coord eval set (free-rider validation)
See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the standing OpenAddresses / GeoNames / WOF attribution.

corpus_version: v257 fragment-campaign corpus (extract-v5) re-tokenized through v0.9.0-multisplice; span-boundary aux head from BIO labels.
unresolved: No digest is recorded for 8 of 8 declared artifacts: postcode-fr.bin, pair-index-fr.bin, fst-fr-fr.bin, fst-street-morphology.bin, anchor-lexicon-v1.json, locality-surface-lexicon-v7.json, street-type-lexicon-v3.json, country-surface-lexicon-v1.json. An unrecorded digest is not a verified one.

This package's model card records no training attribution of its own. It ships 8 artifacts and no model graph, so its own inputs are unattributed here while the 10 entries under inherited_lineage describe @mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us's graph.

Which records trained the model this package ships or inherits is unresolved. `buildCorpus` writes a frozen `TRAINING_SOURCES.json` naming every source that contributed and under which terms, and no released model was built from a corpus carrying one. The corpus named above is the recipe's corpus rather than a record of what reached the model.
